svg.title: REMAKE · single-page learning cheatsheet
svg.desc: All seven REMAKE layers on one landscape US Letter page, in two columns. Same physical key positions, bindings, and colors as keymap.svg. Large legends are tap actions; smaller colored legends are hold actions. The eighth panel contains learning reminders.
svg.metadata: Source assets/keymap.svg sha256: 924b3fd8e0d4daa5cc898eaaf37e83de037de38b6d8f5e7c0021a20c61ea8014; keyboard.toml sha256: f6a97417fb2745bb053ef10978e3d0e70f6e93e374020c8a901dba45da4658e4; palette: Modus Operandi, Protesilaos Stavrou, 20261015.953 (6272f81ae3fe); schematic key placement.
svg.text: Tap = large label · Hold = colored lower label · Tinted thumb = layer selector · — = disabled

g.text: Left: Esc → Media · Enter → Nav · Tab → Mouse
Right: Bksp → Sym · Space → Num · Del → Fun
Home-row mods: Shift A/; · Alt S/L · GUI D/K · Ctrl F/J
Caps Word: hold Enter / Nav and tap H
Bootloader: layer thumb + 2× same-hand Q or P
Vial unlock: hold both center thumbs (Enter + Space)
BT clear: hold a profile selector for 5 seconds
Media bottom: USB/BLE · BT0 · BT1 · BT2 · BT3
Inner thumbs face the controller / center gap

svg.text: US Letter · landscape · fit to page · turn off print headers and footers
